purpose: stress-test the replicated Phase-0 discrete dynamics without changing the passing architecture

training.dynamics: same centroid residual ConvNet, width 64, 30 epochs, lr 0.002

primary_per_seed_gates: ID-long discrete h8 decoded MSE / raw persistence MSE < 1.0
spectrum-OOD discrete h3 decoded MSE / raw persistence MSE < 1.0
combined-OOD discrete h3 decoded MSE / raw persistence MSE < 1.0
phase1_pass: all three fresh model seeds pass all three primary gates; no retries or replacement seeds
secondary_controls: matched raw-continuous residual ConvNet trained with the same width/context/epochs/lr and model seed; report but do not use to redefine pass
report all available horizons and direct-VQ oracle floor
known numerical simulator is a sanity/lower-bound reference, not a learned competitor
failure_policy: retain unfavorable results; infrastructure-incomplete attempts are not scientific evidence and consumed model seeds are not rerun
